name: Jiangxi Tungsten Rare And Precious Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Tungsten Rare And Precious Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the coal mining business. Its products include metallurgical coking coal, washed thermal coal, mixed coal, screened mixed coal, washed fine coal, lump coal, as well as prime coking coal, anthracite, lean coal, and bituminous coal. The company also engages in coal mining, coal beneficiation and processing, coal logistics and trade, coalbed methane development and utilization, mineral product sales, project investment, warehousing services, freight forwarding, equipment repair and leasing, property leasing, and research, information, and technical consulting services.
